title: Neo4j + Graphiti knowledge graph — cross-target attack-chain queries + semantic relationships (parity sprint)
goal: PARITY with PentAGI: add Neo4j knowledge graph via Graphiti library for cross-target attack-chain queries ('which exploits worked on similar tech stacks?'), cross-run pattern detection, multi-hop reasoning. Per Codex: 'pas wanneer relational queries empirisch tekortschieten' — by parity-sprint time we have foundation evidence; this is the upgrade.
scope: (1) Neo4j Docker service added to deployment + Graphiti library to requirements. (2) New `api/app/services/knowledge_graph.py`: write_relationship(source_entity, target_entity, rel_type, attributes) + query_paths(from, to, max_hops) + semantic_neighbors(entity, k). (3) Episodic memory (backlog-410) writes also emit graph relationships for connectable entities (target → finding → captured_value → next_step). (4) Per Codex contamination: benchmark writes tagged + filtered.

Per ANTI_DRIFT.md Rule 1: metric is 'cross-target multi-hop queries return ≥1 actionable result on XBOW after-420 run'.
